mapper.insert: insert into prize_record ( user_id, scene, code, date_str, stage, amount, prize_time, out_biz_no ) values ( #{userId}, #{scene}, #{code}, #{dateStr}, #{stage}, #{amount}, now(), #{outBizNo} )
mapper.update: update prize_record set user_id = #{userId}, scene = #{scene}, code = #{code}, date_str = #{dateStr}, stage = #{stage}, amount = #{amount}, prize_time = now(), out_biz_no = #{outBizNo} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from prize_record where prize_time >= #{startTime} and prize_time <= #{endTime} order by prize_time desc
